description: This Java class 'FieldObject' implements a method object for the Mini Language in the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides mechanisms to access a field value from a given environment map, determine its type, and handle the element configuration for the minilang method.

classes.name: FieldObject
classes.description: A method object that encapsulates access to a specific field within the minilang framework, supporting type determination and object retrieval from a context.

methods.name: FieldObject
methods.description: Constructor initializes the FieldObject with configuration from an XML element and a simple method context, setting up the field accessor and type.

methods.name: getObject
methods.description: Retrieves the value of the specified field from the method context environment map.

methods.name: getTypeClass
methods.description: Returns the Java Class corresponding to the field's type, loaded dynamically based on the configuration.

methods.name: getTypeName
methods.description: Returns the type name of the field as specified in the configuration.
